// Tests named "BUG X-xx" assert the CORRECT behaviour and FAIL on main 9e5403ba.
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { resetDb, testSql } from "./helpers/resetDb";
import { call, callWithEnv, createDevice, type Created } from "./helpers/seed";

const sql = testSql();
beforeEach(() => resetDb(sql));
const noEdge = { VERDICTS_GET_LIMITER: undefined };
async function pair(g: Created, p: Created) {
  const { code } = (await (await call("/family/code", { method: "POST", token: g.token })).json()) as { code: string };
  expect((await call("/family/join", { method: "POST", token: p.token, json: { code } })).status).toBe(200);
}
const scan = (url: string, domain: string, score = 92, status = "blocked", signals: unknown[] = []) => ({ url, domain, score, status, signals, detectedAt: new Date().toISOString() });
const post = (d: Created, json: unknown) => call("/scans", { method: "POST", token: d.token, json });
const verdictOf = async (d: Created, url: string, domain: string) => {
  const res = await callWithEnv(noEdge, `/verdicts?url=${encodeURIComponent(url)}&domain=${encodeURIComponent(domain)}`, { token: d.token });
  return { status: res.status, body: (await res.json()) as { verdict?: { value: string } | null; error?: { message: string } } };
};

describe("extension output -> POST /scans and GET /verdicts", () => {
  it("matrix: every page the extension can block is stored (a 422 is dropped by the extension for good, BH-06)", async () => {
    const p = await createDevice("Ibu");
    const refused: string[] = [];
    for (const c of CASES.urls) {
      const res = await post(p, scan(c.url, c.domain));
      const v = await verdictOf(p, c.url, c.domain);
      const why = res.status === 201 ? "" : ((await res.json()) as { error: { message: string } }).error.message;
      console.log(`H3 scans | ${c.page} | sent domain ${c.domain} | POST /scans ${res.status} ${why} | GET /verdicts ${v.status}`);
      if (res.status !== 201) refused.push(c.page);
    }
    console.log(`H3 scans | rows ${CASES.urls.length} | refused ${refused.length}`);
    expect(refused).toEqual([]); // BUG X-06: fails, lists the pages whose block the Guardian never hears about
  });

  it("the real detector + /analyze signals of one scam page pass the backend schema", async () => {
    const p = await createDevice("Ibu");
    const res = await post(p, scan(CASES.scam.url, CASES.scam.domain, CASES.scam.score, "blocked", CASES.scam.signals));
    console.log(`H3 signals | ${CASES.scam.signals.length} signals, score ${CASES.scam.score} | POST /scans ${res.status}`);
    expect(res.status).toBe(201);
  });
});

describe("not_safe covers the domain except shared hosts (contracts/api.md Verdicts, rule 2)", () => {
  it.each([
    ["https://docs.google.com/forms/d/scam", "google.com", "https://accounts.google.com/signin", "google.com"],
    ["https://forms.office.com/r/scam", "office.com", "https://www.office.com/login", "office.com"],
    ["https://sway.cloud.microsoft/scam", "cloud.microsoft", "https://outlook.cloud.microsoft/mail/", "cloud.microsoft"],
    ["https://1drv.ms/f/scam", "1drv.ms", "https://1drv.ms/w/other", "1drv.ms"],
    ["https://s.id/hadiah", "s.id", "https://s.id/undangan", "s.id"],
    ["https://alice.medium.com/scam", "medium.com", "https://medium.com/@bob/post", "medium.com"],
  ])("BUG X-07 candidate: not_safe on %s must not reach %s (other page of a shared platform)", async (scamUrl, scamDomain, otherUrl, otherDomain) => {
    const g = await createDevice("Gita", "guardian");
    const p = await createDevice("Ibu");
    await pair(g, p);
    const { id } = (await (await post(p, scan(scamUrl, scamDomain))).json()) as { id: string };
    expect((await call("/verdicts", { method: "POST", token: g.token, json: { scanId: id, value: "not_safe", notes: "scam form" } })).status).toBe(200);
    const same = await verdictOf(p, scamUrl, scamDomain);
    const other = await verdictOf(p, otherUrl, otherDomain);
    console.log(`H3 shared | not_safe on ${scamUrl} | same link -> ${same.body.verdict?.value ?? null} | ${otherUrl} -> ${other.body.verdict?.value ?? null}`);
    expect(same.body.verdict?.value).toBe("not_safe");
    expect(other.body.verdict ?? null).toBeNull();
  });
});
